scope: Inside where Illustrator draws none (a compound path with an open contour; type with one fill and one stroke), drawn as two fills: a band fill in the stroke color beneath the item's own fill shrunk by the weight with Illustrator's live Offset Path. Also the InDesign alignment survey. MuPDF; areas in pt2.

offsetPath.method: black area (gray < 128) of the whole page at 150 dpi
offsetPath.reading: Minion "Ax" 96 pt: insets of 1, 2, and 4 shrink it (plain, minus1, minus2, minus4); an inset of 8 (minus) gives the shape back unshrunk, live type and outlined alike. A 60 pt square with a 6 pt bar, inset 4: the bar goes and a 52 pt square (2,704) is left. So native_region::InsetEmpty decides, and the shrunk fill is hidden when the inset leaves nothing.

openClosing.probe: tools/jsx/ai-native-align.jsx before the rule (cmp-in with the triangle open along its whole 60 pt base)
openClosing.method: stroke-gray pixels (64..200) at 600 dpi in the 30 x 8 pt strip above the closing, x 135..165, y 40..48
openClosing.reading: The band ran along the open contour's closing, where no stroke runs. Inside is now refused ("inside-open-closing") when a closing is longer than the weight; cmp-in is now open by 4 pt.

effectHandle.probe: tools/jsx/ai-native-align.jsx with ISE_REGION_ARGS.dump "cmp-in" (region-prep-17 build with a temporary trace)
effectHandle.finding: In the full probe (the document saved as PDF between steps, after earlier rounds), the parsed Offset Path effect on cmp-in reported a handle other than GetLiveEffectHandleByName("Adobe Offset Path"), though its name and tagged parameters were intact, so restore refused ("restore-fills-changed"). The same steps alone (tools/jsx/ai-offset-tag.jsx, with and without a PDF save and an Outside round first) matched. The fix's own effects (Offset Path, Pathfinder Add) are now found by name and tag.

indesign.summary: InDesign 2026 draws Center, Inside, and Outside on closed paths, open paths (side from direction), compound paths including one with an open contour, groups, and a frame's own stroke. Text: Center and Outside only (TextStrokeAlign has CENTER_ALIGNMENT and OUTSIDE_ALIGNMENT; reading INSIDE_ALIGNMENT raises an error try does not catch). The outlined-text cell lost its stroke in the conversion. Run in a windowless document of its own, closed unsaved; the owner's documents checked unchanged.
